title: Annotatio I §.V: Calixtus Senior — Reformed metonymy as admissible ecclesiastical phrase
pass_a_gloss: Calixtus Senior seems to hint the very same in Judgment on the Controversies no. 81, p. m. 136., there calling the Reformers’ metonymic proposition an Ecclesiastical phrase which could be admitted.
pass_b_english: Calixtus Senior points the same way (Judgment on the Controversies §81, p. 136): the Reformers’ metonymic proposition is an ecclesiastical phrase that could be admitted.
source_text: Idem prorsus videtur Calixtus Senior innuere Judicio de controversiis num. 81. pag. m. 136., metonymicam Reformatorum propositionem ibidem Ecclesiasticam phrasin appellando quae admitti posset.
